mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic output.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 5% do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.
